Sequential CIFAR-10 with a fixed seed-42 45000/5000 train/validation split, train-only normalization and no augmentation. Test is reserved for frozen candidates.
budget_limited: 2048 updates (batch 2), zero completed epochs. Historical transformer 8.3% / LSTM 8.6% are near random chance, not acceptance results.
Raw 16000-sample Speech Commands, 12 classes. Training uses a seed-dependent subset without replacement; the original pilot used seed 0. No convergence or full-epoch claim.

Fixed zoology MQAR: vocab 8192, length 64, 8 KV pairs; train/validation generation seeds 123/2147483789. No separate final test split.

Historical pilots are not acceptance results. Sequence mixers must be causal and supply any position information internally.

MAD selective copying baseline only (vocab 16, length 256, copy 16, train 12800/development 1280, lr 0.0005, wd 0, batch 128, maximum 200 epochs). Not the full MAD difficulty/hyperparameter sweep and not Jelassi et al. copy.

The upstream test split is repeatedly monitored by Lightning and treated as development data here. No untouched final test is available; unconditional upstream stopping at accuracy >=0.999 can reduce the epoch budget.
Historical official benchmark: mh_attention_swiglu completed; striped_mh_hyena_moe FAILED; one seed (12345). The other 14 recipes are unverified on Turing.
FlashAttention was replaced by PyTorch SDPA: kernel_exact=false. Some recipes require unavailable CUDA extensions; registration does not establish runtime support. Pilots are not acceptance results.
Current implementation is v2. mlp_sal is constant across the 11 baseline models and must not be used for ranking.
Historical snip/mix_nuc Spearman rho was 0.82; they may be redundant. ntk_cond coordinate-count/coordinate-seed stability is unverified.
mix_nuc is not original DSS++; ntk_cond uses random output projections rather than a standard empirical NTK.
Inputs are uniform random tokens with identical targets; no task-dependent predictive validity has been established. No cross-tier Spearman is measured.
flops and state_cap are analytic controls, not measured runtime/memory. State capacity retains the v2 formulas and assumes two bytes per element even though scoring uses FP32.
Smoke uses probe_len 8 and L 64, so window attention cannot be distinguished from full attention at window 64.

Scaled-down Garg et al. 2022 linear regression: d=20, 41 points per prompt (k=0..40), noiseless y=w.x. Error is (y_hat-y)^2/d on 2048 fixed validation prompts (seed 2147483647); metric is the mean over k=20..40. Per-k errors, the least-squares oracle and the y=0 baseline are in history.json.

Budget: 45000 steps, batch 64, Adam lr 1e-4, Garg curriculum (dims 5->20, points 11->41, every 2000 steps). Transformer 6 layers/8 heads/width 256 (Garg: 12 layers); LSTM 3 layers/width 512. No separate test split; training prompts are freshly sampled from the same distribution.

Inputs are continuous vectors, not tokens: x via Linear(d,D) and scalar y via a separate Linear(1,D), interleaved. mamba is not registered because the pure-torch scan exceeds 30 minutes per seed at this budget.
